title: Player signs in and resets a password
description: Open the login form, use Forgot Password, and see the first-time invite prompt that requires a new password.

steps.title: Login screen
steps.body: Members sign in with email and password. Use Forgot Password if you cannot get in, or set a new password the first time you accept an invite.

steps.title: Forgot Password
steps.body: Request a reset when you cannot sign in. The club emails a link (this capture stops on the request form).

steps.title: Reset request
steps.body: Enter the account email. If the address exists, the club generates a reset token you can use to choose a new password.
steps.resultNote: Forgot Password modal is open; the form is not submitted.

steps.title: First-time invite password
steps.body: Invited members who still have a temporary password must set a new one before using the app.
steps.resultNote: Password Reset Required after signing in with the invite account.
